purpose: Source anchors for the expanding Potatoism correspondence layer. These records establish what is externally documented before the project adds its own interpretation.

records.claim: The vesica piscis/mandorla is the lens-shaped intersection of two equal circles; terminology and later sacred/artistic uses have a documented history.
records.project-use: Supports the geometry layer; does not establish the Potato interpretation.

records.claim: The vesica piscis is formed by two equal circles whose centers lie on one another's circumference; the form has appeared in historical architectural and Christian-art contexts.
Thalamocortical input supports cortical functions and also participates in development of the mature neocortex.
records.source: Annual Review of Neuroscience, Roles of Thalamocortical Axons in Cerebral Cortical Development, 2026
records.project-use: Strengthens the brain-map layer around axons, pathways and development.

records.claim: The thalamus is an important link between peripheral sensory stimuli and cortical circuits, with modality-specific thalamocortical wiring.
records.project-use: Supports eye → thalamus → cortex coupling while keeping the symbolic correspondence separate from anatomy.

records.claim: Cortico-thalamo-cortical loops provide bidirectional communication between cortex and thalamus across sensory, motor and cognitive areas.
records.project-use: Supports the project's move from one-way pathway metaphors to reciprocal loops and feedback.

new_research_implications: Treat vesica geometry as measurable mathematics first, symbolic interpretation second.
Treat thalamus as a network hub with reciprocal pathways rather than a simple one-way gate.
Expand the potato correspondence from shape to developmental process: dormancy, emergence, branching, storage and regeneration.
Expand every symbolic correspondence into a source-backed observation plus a separately labeled project interpretation.
Use feedback loops, not only tree hierarchies, when modeling brain and social systems.
Where a correspondence is weak, preserve it as a research hypothesis rather than deleting it or promoting it to fact.
